name: Sonora
author: Tasos Kanellias
description: A Sonora-styled mini player for the bar: animated waveform, cover art, and a Now Playing card with seek, shuffle, repeat and volume, over MPRIS

barWidget.description: Sonora's now-playing view in your bar: waveform, cover art, and a mini player card.

schema.label: Max label width (px)
schema.description: Width of the now-playing label before it scrolls.

schema.label: Hide when Sonora is not running
schema.description: Remove the widget from the bar while Sonora is closed.

schema.label: Show artist in the bar
schema.description: Append the artist after the track title in the bar label.

schema.label: Show cover art in the bar
schema.description: Show a small album-art thumbnail next to the waveform.

schema.label: Show progress line
schema.description: Draw a hairline playback progress bar under the widget.
